ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white pixels; white pixels are concentrated in large lateral patches.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white contiguous zones are located on the distal third of both lobes. The central and medial regions consist of solid low-intensity black pigmentation. Multiple small, circular black ocelli are nested within the white lateral patches.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Wide, obtuse V-shaped depression with an approximate angle of 115 degrees and moderate bounding-box depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations present along the entire trailing edge. Amplitude of peaks increases in the mid-lobe regions compared to the areas adjacent to the median notch.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave trailing edge curve extending upward and outward toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct high-contrast circular clusters on the extreme distal tips and along the upper trailing edge, indicating barnacle colonization. Several circular 'target' markings (dark rings with light centers) are visible in the white patches.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several distinct, unaligned white linear streaks are visible: one set in the lower-left medial black region and another intersecting the upper-right white patch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Active barnacle colonies are present on the distal tips of both lobes. Multiple circular scars/ocelli are distributed across the pigmented regions.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly distinct pair of symmetrical ocellus-like markings in the lateral white zones of both the left and right lobes.
